explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 51 configurations over 7 sweeps (colocated, colocated-tuned, pd-ratio, pd-always, pd-wide-decode, pd-pool-engine, pd-decode-cudagraph), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.

No configuration that was run held the scenario's SLOs at any tested load, so the 164 runs that were made bound the deployment from below rather than recommending one. 40 further runs were refused and are not evidence of a miss. Refused: 6 configurations (24 runs): scenario: colocated pool: Muse-Spark on h200 (compute capability 9.0) requires data parallelism 1 and prefill-context parallelism 1 (got dp 4, pcp 0): its MoE layers take the route-major Marlin path on Hopper, which vLLM refuses to build with more ("MuseSpark1x Triton/Marlin currently requires DP1 and PCP1", vllm/models/muse_spark/nvidia/muse_moe_runner.py:140-146@0f6b2619). Blackwell is not affected; 2 configurations (8 runs): scenario: colocated pool: Muse-Spark on h200 (compute capability 9.0) requires data parallelism 1 and prefill-context parallelism 1 (got dp 2, pcp 0): its MoE layers take the route-major Marlin path on Hopper, which vLLM refuses to build with more ("MuseSpark1x Triton/Marlin currently requires DP1 and PCP1", vllm/models/muse_spark/nvidia/muse_moe_runner.py:140-146@0f6b2619). Blackwell is not affected; 2 configurations (8 runs): scenario: colocated pool: Muse-Spark on h200 (compute capability 9.0) requires data parallelism 1 and prefill-context parallelism 1 (got dp 8, pcp 0): its MoE layers take the route-major Marlin path on Hopper, which vLLM refuses to build with more ("MuseSpark1x Triton/Marlin currently requires DP1 and PCP1", vllm/models/muse_spark/nvidia/muse_moe_runner.py:140-146@0f6b2619). Blackwell is not affected.
Nothing that ran in this grid is servable under the stated SLOs.
